listingTitle: Document manual Rust Send and Sync contracts
title: Document manual Rust Send and Sync contracts
why: A manual Send or Sync implementation asserts thread-safety properties the compiler could not derive.
suggestion: Attach a SAFETY rationale covering every field, generic bound, aliasing invariant, and thread-affinity constraint.
limitations: The rule verifies documentation presence and cannot prove the implementation is sound.
Adjacent Send and Sync implementations for the same type may share one attached SAFETY rationale; implementations separated by unrelated items are reported independently.
